boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Milwaukee School of Engineering
boards.description: Ten currently documented food destinations with late availability in Milwaukee, selected as under-21-safe options near MSOE.

cards.title: Ian’s Pizza on Juneau
cards.subtitle: 146 E. Juneau Ave., downtown Milwaukee
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm the Friday–Saturday 2 a.m. close before heading over; dine-in, curbside, and carryout are listed.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza-cade with documented weekend service until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Ian's Pizza lists Friday–Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–2 a.m. for its 146 E. Juneau Ave. location.
cards.source_title: Ian’s Pizza — Juneau Avenue Downtown Milwaukee
cards.access_notes: Officially listed Friday–Saturday hours are 11 a.m.–2 a.m.; Sunday–Thursday hours end at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Pizza Shuttle Takeout Window
cards.subtitle: 1827 N. Farwell Ave., East Side
cards.notes: Plan a pickup or delivery order rather than a late dine-in visit: the restaurant lists takeout and delivery until 3 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: Farwell Avenue pizza with officially listed 3 a.m. takeout and delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Shuttle states that its Farwell location offers delivery and takeout daily from 10 a.m. to 3 a.m.
cards.source_title: Pizza Shuttle — About and Location Details
cards.access_notes: Dine-in is listed until midnight; delivery and takeout are listed daily until 3 a.m. Confirm delivery eligibility for the specific address.

cards.title: Toppers on Kenilworth
cards.subtitle: 1903 E. Kenilworth Pl., Milwaukee
cards.notes: Check the day before leaving: the official location listing shows service until 3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 4 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: East Side pizza with late hours extending into early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Toppers lists its Milwaukee Eastside location as open until 3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 4 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official listed hours: 10:30 a.m.–3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday; 10:30 a.m.–4 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: Gyro Palace on South 2nd
cards.subtitle: 602 S. 2nd St., Walker’s Point
cards.notes: Use the Walker’s Point location details when timing a pickup: the restaurant lists late service on every day, with later Friday–Saturday hours.
cards.short_summary: Gyros and Mediterranean food with officially listed service past 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Gyro Palace lists its Walker's Point location open until 2:30 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official listed hours: 10:30 a.m.–2:30 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 a.m.–3:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies on North
cards.subtitle: 1804 E. North Ave., Milwaukee
cards.notes: Make this a late pickup stop and verify the day’s availability before travel; the City’s current extended-hours report lists service through 3 a.m.
cards.short_summary: North Avenue cookies with a current City-issued extended-hours listing.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Milwaukee’s April 2026 extended-hours report lists Insomnia Cookies at 1804 E. North Ave. open until 3 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: City of Milwaukee Extended Hours Establishments License Report
cards.access_notes: City report dated April 9, 2026 lists hours of 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Sunday and 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Monday–Saturday.

cards.title: Ian’s Pizza on North
cards.subtitle: 2035 E. North Ave., Milwaukee
cards.notes: Treat this as a separate East Side location from Ian’s downtown; the current City report lists it through 5 a.m. and gives its exact address.
cards.short_summary: North Avenue Ian’s with a City-listed 5 a.m. closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Milwaukee’s April 2026 extended-hours report lists Ian's Pizza Milwaukee at 2035 E. North Ave. open until 5 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: City of Milwaukee Extended Hours Establishments License Report
cards.access_notes: City report dated April 9, 2026 lists daily hours of 9 a.m.–5 a.m.

cards.title: Mad Chicken on North
cards.subtitle: 2045 E. North Ave., Milwaukee
cards.notes: Confirm the current operating status before departure; the City’s extended-hours license report identifies this North Avenue restaurant and lists 3 a.m. closing.
cards.short_summary: A North Avenue chicken restaurant with documented 3 a.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Milwaukee’s April 2026 extended-hours report lists Mad Chicken at 2045 E. North Ave. open until 3 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: City of Milwaukee Extended Hours Establishments License Report
cards.access_notes: City report dated April 9, 2026 lists daily hours of 9 a.m.–3 a.m.

cards.title: NYPD Pizza on North
cards.subtitle: 231 E. North Ave., Milwaukee
cards.notes: Check the day of your order because the City report shows a different late schedule on weekends, including 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday closes.
cards.short_summary: North Avenue pizza delivery with documented late-weekend service.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Milwaukee’s April 2026 extended-hours report lists NYPD New York Pizza Delivery at 231 E. North Ave. open until 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: City of Milwaukee Extended Hours Establishments License Report
cards.access_notes: City report dated April 9, 2026 lists Friday and Saturday hours ending at 2 a.m.; Sunday–Thursday are listed through 12:59 a.m.

cards.title: American Sub on West North
cards.subtitle: 1114 W. North Ave., Milwaukee
cards.notes: Use the listed address for a late food pickup and verify same-day status; the City’s current report records service until 3 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: West North Avenue sandwich shop with City-listed 3 a.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Milwaukee’s April 2026 extended-hours report lists American Sub at 1114 W. North Ave. open until 3 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: City of Milwaukee Extended Hours Establishments License Report
cards.access_notes: City report dated April 9, 2026 lists daily hours of 10 a.m.–3 a.m.

cards.title: Wendy’s on West North
cards.subtitle: 633 W. North Ave., Milwaukee
cards.notes: Confirm current availability before going, particularly outside the weekend; the City’s current report lists 3 a.m. most nights and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: West North Avenue fast food with documented overnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Milwaukee’s April 2026 extended-hours report lists Wendy's at 633 W. North Ave. open until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: City of Milwaukee Extended Hours Establishments License Report
cards.access_notes: City report dated April 9, 2026 lists 7:30 a.m.–3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 7:30 a.m.–4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
